title: Young Justice
description: Teenage superheroes strive to prove themselves as members of the Justice League.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x1
episodes_data.description: Robin, Aqualad, and Kid Flash break into Cadmus and find that it is being run by Genomorphs.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x2
episodes_data.description: The sidekicks find a clone of Superman known as Superboy. They free him from Cadmus' control, while battling Blockbuster.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x3
episodes_data.description: After Speedy declines to join the new team, Robin, Aqualad and Kid Flash fear Young Justice is just a big joke…while new member Miss Martian fears there's no room for her to be part of it. So when the four heroes and Superboy come up against Mister Twister, it looks like all their fears have just been realized…

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x4
episodes_data.description: Young Justice goes on its first official mission under Batman, while trying to determine which of them will lead the team.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x5
episodes_data.description: Superboy's anger over his non-relationship with Superman is getting out of control. He refuses to train with Black Canary, and when the team faces an opponent that even the Justice League had trouble defeating, the Boy of Steel goes rogue.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x6
episodes_data.description: Green Arrow's niece, Artemis, joins Young Justice and must save a bright young scientist from the League of Shadows.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x7
episodes_data.description: When the team investigates the disappearance of Kent Nelson (formerly Doctor Fate), the scientific-minded Wally West is forced to confront his disbelief in magic while battling Abra Kadabra and Klarion the Witch Boy, for the ultra-powerful Helmet of Fate.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x8
episodes_data.description: After a disastrous mission with the team, Aqualad returns to Atlantis to choose between a life on the surface world or one beneath the waves with the Aquagirl of his dreams. But other forces at play may make Aqualad's decision for him.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x9
episodes_data.description: Young Justice discovers that they have forgotten the last six months of their lives, including each other and a final fateful mission in Bialya. The team turns to Miss Martian to recover their memories, before it is too late for Superboy.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x10
episodes_data.description: Red Arrow is on his own against the world's most dangerous assassins in preventing the League of Shadows from starting a war, until he is forced to make an unlikely alliance with someone even more dangerous. Aqualad fails to convince Red Arrow to ask the team for help.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x11
episodes_data.description: Superboy and Miss Martian go undercover inside Belle Reve Penitentiary.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x12
episodes_data.description: When Mount Justice itself is attacked, can Artemis and Robin (the two teens without super-powers) save the Team (or even themselves) from the unknown invaders?

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x13
episodes_data.description: Already exhausted and rattled after a home turf invasion of The Cave, the team learns that Aqualad - their friend and leader - withheld vital information that put them all at risk. When Batman sends the Team and new "den-mother" Captain Marvel to India to investigate bizarre reports of armed animals attacking human beings, can Aqualad pull his fractured team together?

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x14
episodes_data.description: When Plant Creatures attack major cities around the world, the team is eager to join the fight alongside the Justice League. Instead, Batman assigns them a still more dangerous task - taking out the plants' masters: a secret society of super- villains: the Injustice League!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x15
episodes_data.description: The team is on the hunt for Red Tornado, determined to find out once and for all whether the robot was the mole - even if it means kidnapping new friend Zatanna and dragging her along on their quest!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x16
episodes_data.description: When the Justice League is defeated during an alien invasion, the Team has to step up and fill their mentors shoes.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x17
episodes_data.description: Superboy's "Sphere" goes through a surprising change, revealing a connection to the forever people of New Genesis.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x18
episodes_data.description: It's Halloween. Artemis and Zatanna are in Manhattan for a girls' night out. There, they encounter the deadly Harm, who has a secret.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x19
episodes_data.description: When every adult on the planet disappears, only the team, Zatanna, and Billy Batson are left to defeat the five most powerful sorcerers on Earth. In the end, Zatanna officialy joins the team and Zatara becomes the new Doctor Fate.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x20
episodes_data.description: Wally West comes oh-so-close to fulfilling his birthday wish to finally fight alongside the Justice League. Instead, a massively disappointed Kid Flash is taken off the mission and tasked with a simple delivery job. But a few deadly surprises await the birthday boy along the way.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x21
episodes_data.description: A covert operation against Queen Bee in Qurac forces Miss Martian to finally face her greatest fears and her biggest secrets. But will she reveal those secrets to her friends—or allow what she's hiding to take down the entire team?

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x22
episodes_data.description: Superboy returns to Project Cadmus, where he learns the top-secret genetics lab may have created another Super-clone.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x23
episodes_data.description: Red Arrow's return undercuts Artemis' confidence, while the team's mission to track down Sportsmaster threatens to expose her darkest secrets.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x24
episodes_data.description: The Team goes undercover at the Haly International Traveling Circus to locate a thief stealing weapons technology across Europe. But a thief isn’t all they find…

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x25
episodes_data.description: The Team gets a new member and a new mission – a mission that may finally expose all the Team’s secrets... and all their lies!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 1x26
episodes_data.description: The Team finally learns the identity of the traitor in their midst, forcing a battle against an enemy more dangerous than any they’ve ever faced before!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x1
episodes_data.description: The Team takes on the intergalactic bounty hunter Lobo…as a precursor to an alien invasion!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x2
episodes_data.description: Miss Martian, Superboy, Beast Boy and Adam Strange arrive on the distant planet Rann to stop the alien infiltration of Earth at its source.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x3
episodes_data.description: The Team and the Justice League continue to hunt the Kroloteans that have invaded Earth—but the aliens have help from an extremely unexpected source.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x4
episodes_data.description: While Superboy and Blue Beetle battle Intergang, Nightwing and company try to salvage the soul of a former comrade fallen from grace.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x5
episodes_data.description: Jaime Reyes searches for a missing friend, while Miss Martian, Batgirl, Bumblebee and Wonder Girl return to Bialya to discover what lies beneath.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x6
episodes_data.description: An intruder mysteriously appears inside Mount Justice, claiming to be a tourist from the future. But who is he really? And what is his true agenda?

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x7
episodes_data.description: Artemis rejoins the team to defend a critical satellite launch. But will her first mission back also be her last?!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x8
episodes_data.description: Roy Harper seeks vengeance against the man who ruined his life.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x9
episodes_data.description: Black Manta sends Kaldur on a mission that will prove where his loyalties truly lie.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x10
episodes_data.description: The Team uncovers some shocking secrets while on a covert rescue mission.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x11
episodes_data.description: A brutal alien warrior traps the Team inside the Hall of Justice.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x12
episodes_data.description: Robin leads a squad to investigate Lexcorp's troubling allegiances.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x13
episodes_data.description: In revenge for her telepathic attack on his son, Black Manta goes after Miss Martian.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x14
episodes_data.description: Nightwing tasks Blue Beetle with chasing down a group of potentially dangerous super-powered teenage runaways. But Blue Beetle is not the only one hunting them...

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x15
episodes_data.description: A conqueror from another world becomes a wild card in an intergalactic game of supremacy -- placing planet Earth square in the jackpot.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x16
episodes_data.description: Black Manta gives Miss Martian twenty-four hours to live, but that may be more time than Aqualad has with Sportsmaster and Cheshire on the hunt for his head!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x17
episodes_data.description: A band of misfits is put to the test when Lex Luthor sends them behind enemy lines... to rescue the team!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x18
episodes_data.description: The team embarks on a desperate endeavor to free Blue Beetle!!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x19
episodes_data.description: The Light calls a summit to decide the final fate of Aqualad, the team ... and the entire planet Earth!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice 2x20
episodes_data.description: On the verge of finally ending the alien invasion, the team discovers the price of victory may be the entire planet Earth!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After the Justice League faces a horrifying incident on the planet Rann, Dick Grayson gathers an elite squad of heroes to shut down a meta-human trafficking syndicate in Markovia.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Dick Grayson, Artemis Crock, Conner Kent and Jefferson Pierce go undercover in Markovia to stop the Bedlam Syndicate's meta-human trafficking cartel – before it claims another victim

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Conner Kent and Prince Biron Markov are in the clutches of Count Vertigo, leaving Dick Grayson, Artemis Crock and an emotionally damaged Jefferson Pierce to save them and put an end to the Bedlam Syndicate.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: After the Justice League faces a horrifying incident on the planet Rann, Dick Grayson gathers an elite squad of heroes to shut down a meta-human trafficking syndicate in Markovia.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Dick Grayson, Artemis Crock, Conner Kent and Jefferson Pierce go undercover in Markovia to stop the Bedlam Syndicate's meta-human trafficking cartel – before it claims another victim

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Brion Markov is determined to rescue his missing sister – even if it means throwing down against the entire League of Shadows.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Aliens again threaten the Earth, but with the Justice League split and scattered, only the planet’s first and greatest hero can save the day.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: As Meta-Human trafficking spreads across the United States, three very different teams of heroes hope to put a stop to it.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The Light has hired an intergalactic assassin, but who is the intended target?!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The search for Tara Markov continues – but who’s doing the searching and where?!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: It’s the first day of school for Violet Harper and Forager. And the last day for a different freak…

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Garfield Logan tests out a pair of Goode VR goggles. Then the goggles test him!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Grayson’s operatives attempt to stop an auction of enslaved meta-teens.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: The team reassembles as the Justice League faces a new threat in space.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: A new Gamma Squad team is sent out on its first mission to investigate rumors of meta-trafficking in Russia.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Across the nation, the team members give thanks for what they have -- and for what they very well might lose.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: The Reach are back, terrorizing small town America… unless the Outsiders can stop them!

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Project Rutabaga threatens to create an international crisis for the Outsiders.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: The Outsiders face Lex Luthor's machinations, but Lex is not the only one trying to manipulate them.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Victor Stone reaches a crisis point -- but he's not the only one.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Dick Grayson and Jefferson go after Gretchen Goode -- and they encounter the ominous Overlord.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: The betrayals come fast and furious -- and with them is a reckoning.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: The hunt for Halo is on.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: The Outsiders make a final attempt to save Halo -- and the galaxy.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: Artemis and Conner journey back to their pasts during the calm before the storm.

episodes_data.title: Young Justice Season 3 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: Things come full circle as the team and the Outsiders return to Markovia for a final confrontation.
